notes: db and share per node are against the >=2 mm/day ('moderate') noisy-OR; the heavy band is >=8 mm/day. Both link tables are in schema.edges[*].params.
state is the ensemble members' most common state; db is computed from the full member histogram, which is not stored, so p_link at state is a parameter, not a recomputation of db.
Node states are percentile bands of these 55 basins in this window, not absolute levels.
fluvial is reported beside the belief and never combined (combined=false).
Every number in this file is a Layer 4 field or a parameter of a table in provenance.tables; quote, do not derive.
